chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea on Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard. This deals 15 damage and blocks 5 of the telegraphed 8 damage.
q2_other_line_considered: Watatsumi Levy followed by one attack, but Muster 2 has an unspecified random result and gives up the known combination of 15 damage and 5 Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up spending 6 Charge to Muster 2 and the possible value of the random Inazuma Companion transformations.
q4_different_intent: No. With the two attacks costing 2 Energy total, Coral Guard is the only remaining affordable card, so a different telegraphed intent would not produce a better known use of the third Energy.
